about_credits: This build runs the Go decryption core directly, with no JavaScript UI layer in between.
about_legal_body: Provided as-is for security research. The author accepts no liability for damage or legal consequences arising from its use. You are solely responsible for complying with the laws that apply to you.
about_privacy_body: Pantegnos ships with zero permissions — no INTERNET, no storage. Configs are decoded by the same Go core that powers the CLI and the web decryptor, compiled to WebAssembly and executed inside a sandboxed runtime in this process.
brand_tagline: On-device decryptor for VPN & proxy config files
cd_empty_body: Pick a config file above. Everything is processed on this device — no upload, no account, no tracking.
drop_hint: Tap to browse your device — one file or a whole batch
format_bpf: sing-box profile export — gzip container, no cipher
format_happ: Happ proxy — RSA private key envelope
format_hat: HA Tunnel Plus — AES-ECB with SHA-1 derived key
format_nm: NetMod — AES-ECB with a fixed key
format_slip: SlipNet profile — plaintext or AES-256-GCM envelope
format_tls: TLS Tunnel — AES-256-GCM profile with a reversed-base64 payload
format_zsx: ZedSecure vault — AES-256-GCM with optional Argon2id password
msg_engine_not_ready: The decryption engine is not ready yet
msg_too_large: This file is too large to process safely
password_body: %s is passphrase protected. Enter the password to decrypt it.
paste_unsupported: Clipboard does not hold a config URI (…://)
privacy_chip: No network permission — files never leave this device
viewer_truncated: Preview trimmed — save or share the file for the full output.
